fields.summary: Autonomous plan-bug run, no owner. The bug request (plan run 01M76583, 2026-11-11) names the failure: a round-3 reviewer's rhiza run findings was refused because a finding named a depends-on link's ID, the reviewer had chained rhiza session done with ';', so the review step passed with no round journaled; review-check then judged round 2 again and revise exceeded max_visits. The planner took the request's four-part fix as the plan, serving m4-runs-hold-up (runs finish without hand repair) as earlier run-repair bug fixes do: (1) the review step passes only when its visit journaled a new findings round, and session done refuses for a reviewer without one; (2) review-check refuses to judge a round that predates the latest revise; (3) run findings accepts a link as a finding's target; (4) the plan-review guide tells every role not to chain session done after a command that can fail. No owner words; no question was raised.
fields.title: Plan of the bug fix for unrecorded plan review rounds (autonomous plan-bug run)
